dialogueLines: Oh, hi there! Are you new here too?
This town is... quiet. Maybe too quiet.
Watch out for the house on the hill. Strange things happen there at night.
Have you seen Rin around? She's always sneaking up on me...
*appears behind you* Boo~!
Ehehe~ Did I scare you? I'm Rin!
This tail? It's 100% real! Want to touch it?
June is so fun to tease~ She gets so flustered!
Hey! I'm Lucy, spy extraordinaire! ...Don't tell anyone.
I was sent here on a Very Important Mission! What was it again...?
Have you seen any cute elves around? Asking for... research purposes.
Priestess Tiamat is going to be SO mad if I mess this up...
O-oh! A visitor! Welcome to our forest!
I'm training to become a Forest Guardian someday!
The forest is usually peaceful... but lately something feels different.
Would you like some elvish tea? I just brewed a fresh pot!
Halt! State your business in the Elven Forest.
I am Thea, Forest Guardian. The forest is under my protection.
Rules exist for a reason. Follow them or face the consequences.
...That succubus has been causing trouble again, hasn't she?
